prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-16.8s) - Creating right triangle
# Create triangle points
triangle = Polygon(
    [-2, -1, 0], [1, -1, 0], [-2, 1, 0],
    color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).move_to([-2, -1, 0]).rotate(PI/4)
title = Text("Understanding Trigonometric Ratios", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)

self.play(
    Create(triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    Write(title),
    run_time=3
)

hyp_label = Text("Hypotenuse", font_size=24).next_to(
    triangle.get_center(), UP+RIGHT
)
hyp_arrow = Arrow(
    hyp_label.get_bottom(),
    triangle.get_center(),
    buff=0.2,
    color=YELLOW
)

self.play(
    Write(hyp_label),
    Create(hyp_arrow),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(11.8)  # Complete 16.8s segment

# Segment 2 (16.8-41.1s) - Labeling angle and sides
angle_a = Arc(
    radius=0.5,
    angle=triangle.get_angle(),
    start_angle=0,
    color=BLUE
).move_to([-2, -1, 0]).shift(RIGHT*0.5)

angle_label = MathTex("A").next_to(angle_a, RIGHT, buff=0.1)

self.play(
    Create(angle_a),
    Write(angle_label),
    run_time=2
)

opp_label = Text("Opposite", font_size=24).next_to(triangle, LEFT)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", font_size=24).next_to(triangle, DOWN)

opp_arrow = Arrow(
    opp_label.get_right(),
    [-2, 0, 0],
    buff=0.2,
    color=RED
)
adj_arrow = Arrow(
    adj_label.get_top(),
    [-0.5, -1, 0],
    buff=0.2,
    color=GREEN
)

self.play(
    Write(opp_label),
    Create(opp_arrow),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    Write(adj_label),
    Create(adj_arrow),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(18.4)  # Complete 41.1s segment

# Segment 3 (41.1-55.8s) - Introducing sine ratio
sine_formula = MathTex(
    r"\sin A = \frac{\text{Opposite}}{\text{Hypotenuse}}"
).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    Write(sine_formula),
    run_time=3
)

highlight_opp = triangle.copy().set_color(RED)
highlight_hyp = triangle.copy().set_color(YELLOW)

self.play(
    FadeIn(highlight_opp),
    FadeOut(highlight_opp),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(
    FadeIn(highlight_hyp),
    FadeOut(highlight_hyp),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.7)  # Complete 55.8s segment

# Segment 4 (55.8-78.7s) - Cosine and tangent
cosine_formula = MathTex(
    r"\cos A = \frac{\text{Adjacent}}{\text{Hypotenuse}}"
).next_to(sine_formula, DOWN, buff=0.3)

tangent_formula = MathTex(
    r"\tan A = \frac{\text{Opposite}}{\text{Adjacent}}"
).next_to(cosine_formula, DOWN, buff=0.3)

self.play(
    Write(cosine_formula),
    run_time=3
)

highlight_adj = triangle.copy().set_color(GREEN)
self.play(
    FadeIn(highlight_adj),
    FadeOut(highlight_adj),
    run_time=2
)

self.play(
    Write(tangent_formula),
    run_time=3
)

sohcahtoa = Text("SOH CAH TOA", font_size=36, color=YELLOW).to_edge(DOWN)
self.play(
    Write(sohcahtoa),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(12.9)  # Complete 78.7s segment
